stable.notes: v0.43.0: the pinout diagram belongs to the housing (Housings tab gets the pinout box, canvas resolves connector -> housing, two connectors on one housing share one pinout); nets in the node dialog - Net band on the wire table, Group by Net / Function / Connector / Remote device / Wire part with collapsible groups, search, Node switch, Matrix tab; blank wire rows are saved and never vanish; Add Device offers every cavity of the new connectors as a wire row. Needs the 2026-09-22_pinout_to_housing.sql catalog migration (and 2026-09-22_housing_cavities.sql from v0.42.0).

beta.notes:
Harness CAD 0.47.0 (beta)

- Parts Database → Wires: every cable conductor has its own Ø (one conductor = the Outer Diameter; a cable's Outer Diameter is the jacket), plus a Shield row with its own cross section (22 AWG default) and Ø.
- Design Rule Check judges a cable row as the conductor it is: cavity fill by its own Ø, terminal range and splice cross section by its own size — never the jacket.
- Node dialog: the Wire dropdown lists each cable conductor and the shield; picking one sets the conductor.
- File → Settings… → Length: mm, cm, m or in.
- The wire table sorts only when a column title is clicked; right-click Add Connection Above / Below.
- A selected cell keeps its Design Rule Check colour (the selection is a frame).
- "Manually set" is flagged only when the catalog disagrees with the hand-set pin.
- Fixes: a conductor picked by a function default survives reopening the node dialog; selecting a wire in the Parts Database no longer reads "Modified".
